records.title: Budget Allocation for Education Sector
details: b to c: Union Budget 2026-27 has announced setting up of 5 University Townships in the vicinity of major industrial and logistic corridors and 1 girls' hostel in every district through Viability Gap Funding /capital support to encourage enrolment of girls in STEM institutes/ courses.

records.title: Construction of NHs in Bundelkhand.
details: a to d): 6 number of NH development projects in about 75 km length have been identified for taking up in the districts of Jhansi, Lalitpur, Banda and Chitrakoot.
